title: SoldSMP
description: Modern Economy Survival server with custom shops, teams, RTP, crates and player warps.
body:
Welcome to SoldSMP!

SoldSMP is a modern Economy Survival server focused on grinding, building and trading. Earn money, create farms, buy items in the custom shop, team up with friends and become the richest player on the server.

Features:
• Balanced Economy
• Auction House
• Teams
• Random Teleport
• Player Warps
• Custom Shops
• Crates
• Daily Rewards
• Leaderboards
• Paper 1.21.x
